name: 1Zland #2
description: This unique digital rarity is released simultaneously with the arrival of the 250 edition limited vinyl release of 1Zhuayo by Cristian Vogel. The double vinyl will be released through the legendary Editions Mille Plateaux label ( Force Inc. ). But for those also looking to have a feel of the 1Zhuayo Express, here is a unique opportunity to mint your own NFT.

signatures.message: I, Cristian Vogel have issued an Async Art Blueprint "1Zhuayo" on contract address 0x71925638b9998ab631c83873d9ed19ef9b70ecf0 with an edition count of 8.
